findings.title: Live public metadata must never backfill historical as_of
findings.remediation: public_metadata.assert_live_read_allowed fail-closed for historical as_of; adversarial probe added

findings.title: Later-era snapshot must not answer earlier as_of
findings.remediation: select_snapshot_for_as_of chooses max availability_ms <= as_of; assert_not_today_for_past rejects future/live eras

findings.title: Observation timestamps after as_of are future leaks
findings.remediation: evaluate_instrument rejects FUTURE_OBSERVATION_LEAK fail-closed before scoring

findings.title: Fixture checksum must detect instrument injection
findings.remediation: source_checksum covers symbol set + per-instrument hashes; tamper probe asserts mismatch
